decision.reason: The only thing the evidence shows is that ciliumnodeconfigs.yaml is in the v1.17.0 CRD set [ev-2be643334952] and missing from the v1.15.6 set [ev-c4d8808f9d36]. Every excerpt is just "---". Nothing says whether an environment that doesn't install this CRD sees something fail, such as the agent or operator needing it, or whether there's no effect at all. The proposed behavior-change statement mixes a vague "becomes available" with a mandatory install step that isn't supported, and the "install CRDs before upgrading" line is generic advice from the diff, not an upstream statement. To decide between none and a failure kind, we need upstream release notes or an upgrade-guide passage saying whether Cilium needs CiliumNodeConfig to be installed.
